description.value: The Audain Art Museum is a purpose-built art museum in Whistler housing a permanent collection of over 300 works tracing British Columbia art history from the 18th century to the present day. It holds one of the world's finest collections of Northwest Coast First Nations masks alongside a comprehensive Emily Carr collection and works by major contemporary BC artists such as Jeff Wall and Stan Douglas. The award-winning building sits on the unceded territory of the Sḵwx̱wú7mesh (Squamish) and Lil̓wat7úl (Lil'wat) Nations.
